steps.label: Projekt entpacken
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/hook" && rm -rf src public_new && tar xzf hook.tgz && ls public | wc -l

steps.label: Video rendern
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/hook" && s=$(date +%s) && npx remotion render src/index.jsx P out.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=16 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error && e=$(date +%s) && echo "render_seconds $((e-s))" > render_time.txt

steps.label: Ton anlegen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/hook" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out.mp4 -i mix.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest hook_final.mp4 && ls -la hook_final.mp4 >> render_time.txt
